personal.name: Fairoz Bashir
personal.title: Political Analyst & Policy Researcher
personal.bio: Specializing in geopolitical risk assessment, electoral forecasting, and strategic foreign policy. I bridge empirical social data with executive decision-making to clarify complex global trends. With over 6 years of research experience across think tanks and diplomatic institutions, I deliver actionable intelligence on global trade, legislative shifts, and security dynamics. Passionate about evidence-based governance and international affairs.

paragraphs: I am a dedicated Political Analyst with a robust background in international relations, public policy analysis, and quantitative political research. My core focus centers on deciphering how global geopolitical shifts influence market stability, national elections, and international regulatory frameworks.

Throughout my career, I have collaborated with diplomatic missions, independent policy institutes, and international organizations to produce rigorous, data-backed policy briefings. My long-term goal is to shape proactive foreign policy frameworks that foster diplomatic resilience and sustainable regional stability.
